policy._why: 13 weeks is the point where pages become markedly more likely to lose AI citations, and recency is the strongest single correlate of being cited. The ceiling is refresh capacity times that window: publish faster than the library can be maintained and the tail ages out of citability.

warnings: library_over_ceiling: 3365 pages against a ceiling of 325 (25 substantive refreshes per week held inside 91 days). 3040 pages cannot be kept current at this capacity.
uniform_lastmod: 3365 of 3365 pages share a lastmod inside 7 days - that is a date bump pattern, not a refresh, and it makes the freshness signal meaningless
